task.description:
Write the test specification and integration tests for PD-10 (Definition search).

Read `docs/requirements/PD-10.md` and `src/design/definition.md` §PD-10 before writing tests. Use `tests/specs/PD-09.md` and `tests/integration/pd09_export_import_test.zig` as structural templates.

### Test specification

Create `tests/specs/PD-10.md` with test cases covering all PD-10 acceptance criteria:

| TC ID | Description | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| TC-PD-10-01 | Search with a query that matches definition name exactly | HTTP 200; matching definition in results; rank > description-only match |
| TC-PD-10-02 | Search with a query that matches definition name partially | HTTP 200; matching definition in results |
| TC-PD-10-03 | Search with a query that matches definition description only | HTTP 200; matching definition in results; rank lower than name match |
| TC-PD-10-04 | Search with a query that matches no definitions | HTTP 200; empty array |
| TC-PD-10-05 | Search with empty query string (q=) | HTTP 422; error: query_empty |
| TC-PD-10-06 | Search with query > 512 characters | HTTP 422; error: query_too_long |
| TC-PD-10-07 | Search is case-insensitive (query in uppercase, definition name in lowercase) | HTTP 200; definition found |
| TC-PD-10-08 | Results are ordered by relevance (name match before description match) | HTTP 200; name-matching definition appears before description-only match |
| TC-PD-10-09 | Pagination: limit and offset params control result count | HTTP 200; correct slice of results |
| TC-PD-10-10 | Query containing SQL-special characters (', %, _) | HTTP 200; safe handling; no injection |
| TC-PD-10-11 | Query absent from URL (no ?q= at all) | HTTP 422; error: query_empty |
| TC-PD-10-12 | Search across definitions in DRAFT, ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED statuses | HTTP 200; all statuses returned |

### Integration test file

Create `tests/integration/pd10_search_test.zig` with real database tests covering TC-PD-10-01 through TC-PD-10-12. Follow the patterns in `tests/integration/pd09_export_import_test.zig`:
- Use `TestHarness` for DB setup/teardown
- No `SkipZigTest` stubs — all test cases must have real assertions
- Each test creates its own definitions via `Store.create()` then calls `Store.search()`

### Unit test file (optional but preferred)

Create `tests/unit/pd10_search_unit_test.zig` covering input validation only (QueryEmpty, QueryTooLong) without requiring a database connection.

### Validation

After writing tests, run `zig build test` and verify it exits 0 (unit tests pass; integration tests may require BPM_TEST_DB_URL).
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/PD-10.md created with 12 test cases covering all ACs
tests/integration/pd10_search_test.zig created with real assertions (no SkipZigTest)
tests/unit/pd10_search_unit_test.zig created for validation unit tests

result.summary: Test spec and test code for PD-10 (Definition search). Created tests/specs/PD-10.md with 12 test cases (TC-PD-10-01 through TC-PD-10-12), tests/unit/pd10_search_unit_test.zig covering all input-validation paths (TC-05, TC-06, TC-11) without a DB, and tests/integration/pd10_search_test.zig covering all 12 TCs against a real database. Registered pd10_search_unit_tests in build.zig and pd10_search_integration in tests/integration/main_test.zig. zig build test exits 0.
